crossRefs.note: Hazael said, “Why do you weep, my lord?” He answered, “Because I know the evil that you will do to the children of…
In those days Yahweh began to cut away parts of Israel; and Hazael struck them in all the borders of Israel;
The heart is deceitful above all things and it is exceedingly corrupt. Who can know it?
Therefore let him who thinks he stands be careful that he doesn’t fall.

parallels.note: Then he began to curse and to swear, “I don’t know the man!” Immediately the rooster crowed.

translations.web: But he began to curse, and to swear, “I don’t know this man of whom you speak!”
translations.bsb: But he began to curse and swear, “I do not know this man of whom you speak!”
translations.kjv: But he began to curse and to swear, saying, I know not this man of whom ye speak.
translations.asv: But he began to curse, and to swear, I know not this man of whom ye speak.
